name.value: Malahat Mountain Meadows RV Resort & Campground - Campsite

description.value: Private RV resort near the Malahat summit, set among giant cedars on the Trans-Canada with flush washrooms, hot showers, and laundry; unserviced tent 'nature sites' are available, but cyclists must approach southbound — northbound riders need to overshoot and U-turn at South Shawnigan Lake.

address.value: 304 Trans Canada Hwy, Malahat, BC V0R 2L0

raw_osm.description: Open year round. Hot showers, laundromat.
raw_osm.name: Malahat Mountain Meadows RV Resort & Campground - Campsite

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at victoriacampgrounds.com is fully accessible and serves as the primary evidence source. OSM tags (hot showers, laundromat, toilets, internet_access=yes, power_supply=yes) are all corroborated by the website's /rvpark.htm and front page. The contact page supplies a phone number and address absent from OSM, while the directions page reveals a notable access constraint for cyclists: entry requires southbound travel on Hwy 1.
concerns: OSM community field lists 'Sidney' but the campground is physically located in Malahat, BC—these are different communities approximately 35 km apart.

Name discrepancy: OSM uses 'RV Resort & Campground - Campsite' but the website consistently uses 'RV Park & Campground'; the '- Campsite' suffix appears to be an OSM artifact rather than the official business name.
OSM record had no phone or address; both were sourced from the website's contact page.
Directions page warns that the entrance can only be safely accessed southbound on Hwy 1—cyclists arriving from the north must overshoot approximately 1 km and U-turn at the South Shawnigan Lake exit.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A well-established, year-round campground with confirmed showers, laundry, and walkable food and fuel—strong utility for touring cyclists on the Trans-Canada between Victoria and the Cowichan Valley.

wow_evidence: flush washrooms, hot showers, and laundry; year-round on Trans-Canada
